tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badzra yo gi nī ye/

de la 'dir dbang thob cing*/ byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin pa'i gang zag gis/ bsdus pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs yul gsal btab nas/ bdag sogs 'gro kun deng nas byang chub bar// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// rdzogs byang go 'phang la brten sems can kun// bsgral phyir zab mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos// dmar gsal ḍā ru thod pa kha ṭwāṃ bsnams// rus pa'i rgyan mdzes rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen bla ma la// snying nas gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs// bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim pa yis// rang sems bam̐ yig spros bral dbyings su yal// de yi ngang las snying gar e e las// chos 'byung zla dkyil dbus su bam̐ yig mthar// sngags 'phreng 'khor ba'i zer gyis gzhi lus sbyangs// 'od kyi phung por gyur las skad cig gis// rang nyid pad nyi dus mtshan 'jigs byed steng*// rnam snang rigs bdag bcas pa'i rnal 'byor ma// dmar gsal spyan gsum nam mkha'i dbyings su gzigs// phyag g.yas gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin// g.yon pas thod khrag steng phyogs bzung bas gsol// phrag pa g.yon par rdo rje'i kha ṭwāṃ bsten// thod skam dbu rgyan do shal phyag rgyas spras// zhabs zung g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum dor thabs bzhengs// bde chen nyams 'bar ye shes me dbus rol// thugs srog 'od kyis snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing skur lam gyis gsal// 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas// lhan skyes zhing sngags rnal 'byor ma dpal kun// tshur 'dus dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs rang la thim// dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med par gyur// oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/

lus gnas so sor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// ngo bo lha la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs// oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ dang*// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa rnams kyis mtshan pa yi// thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng bcas pa las// 'phros pa'i 'od kyis 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs nus mthu kun// bsdus thim mkha' spyod dngos grub thob par gyur// oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ dam bca'i grangs las mi nyung ba bzla/ spro na yid bzlas sogs kyi mthar/ bla ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// 'gro kun mkha' spyod 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// khams gsum 'od zhu rang dang rang nyid kyang*// nā da'i bar thim 'od gsal dbyings su yal// slar yang rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa yi// lha sku go chas mtshan par gsal ba'i ngang*// snang grags rtog tshogs lha sngags chos kyi sku// dga' ba gsum dang dbyer med 'dres par gyur// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang 'grub gyur nas// srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa kun sel zhing*// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang las dang po pa dang blo gros dman pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos dpal rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwar lhag bsam dag pas bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
